places.name: The Saffron Plaza
places.epithet: The Weave's door to the eastern sea
places.text: A plaza-port square where spice, dye, resin and saffron come ashore and are first sold.
places.source: Of Emberweave, the Burning Gate of the South

places.name: The Temple of Two Altars
places.epithet: A Dustveil altar and a sea-shrine
places.text: The only temple on the coast with a Dustveil altar for those who go inland and a sea-shrine for those who go out, and it keeps both busy.
places.source: Of Emberweave, the Burning Gate of the South

places.name: The Harbour Shrine
places.text: The temple's sea-shrine keeps a lamp at the end of the quays as well, lit for every ship still out.
places.source: Of Emberweave, the Burning Gate of the South

places.name: The Spice Warehouses
places.epithet: Most of the spice stalls in the city quarter are stocked from here
places.text: Long warehouses along the quay, cool and dark and overwhelming, where the spice waits for the caravans up the Saffron Road.
places.source: Of Emberweave, the Burning Gate of the South

places.name: The Dye-House
places.text: Where dyes landed from the east are tested and mixed before going upriver to Dyewater's vats.

places.name: The Emberfall Factory
places.text: The house of the Emberfall trading houses' factors, where contracts with the tiefling ports are written in very small ink.
places.source: Of Emberweave, the Burning Gate of the South

places.name: The Pepper Lanes
places.text: The streets north of the river, where spice is ground, bagged and argued over.

places.name: The Saffron Road
places.text: West through Tuskhold and Slagbarrow, past the foot of Emberpeak, to Fjerfi.
places.source: Of Emberweave, the Burning Gate of the South
